description: Implementation of Storage Service Request Handler interface for TR-069 host interface, managing storage service instances, handling get/set messages, and synchronization.

classes.name: StorageSrvcReqHandler
classes.description: Handles storage service requests, singleton pattern, manages initialization, deinitialization, and message handling.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns singleton instance of StorageSrvcReqHandler, creating it if necessary with thread safety.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the handler; currently always returns true.

methods.name: unInit
methods.description: Deinitializes the handler, closing all storage service instances.

methods.name: handleSetMsg
methods.description: Handles set requests; currently not supported, returns NOT_HANDLED.

methods.name: handleGetMsg
methods.description: Handles get requests for storage service parameters, including specific handling for 'Device.services.StorageServiceNumberOfEntries' and component instances.
